bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/admin1/server-core
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7fede271a9459b998935e1ae9995d7feba27d9c5
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' server-core-bounded-host)" = gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-7fede271
! docker inspect server-core-bounded-host-nohealth-pr345 >/dev/null 2>&1
activation=$(cat <<'SH'
set -Eeuo pipefail
old=server-core-bounded-host
backup=server-core-bounded-host-nohealth-pr345
img=gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-7fede271
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$old")" = true
! docker inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1
docker stop "$old" >/dev/null
if ! docker rename "$old" "$backup"; then
  docker start "$old" >/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
rollback() {
  trap - ERR
  docker rm -f "$old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  docker rename "$backup" "$old"
  docker start "$old" >/dev/null
  exit 80
}
trap rollback ERR
docker run -d --name "$old" --network gace-internal --init --user 1000:1000 --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit 64 --memory 192m --tmpfs /tmp:size=32m,mode=1777 --restart unless-stopped --health-cmd "python3 -c 'import urllib.request; assert urllib.request.urlopen(\"http://127.0.0.1:8789/healthz\",timeout=3).status == 200'" --health-interval=15s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=3 --volumes-from "$backup":ro --env-file <(docker inspect -f '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' "$backup") "$img" >/dev/null
sleep 20
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$old")" = healthy
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$old")" = "$img"
trap - ERR
SH
)
systemd-run --user --on-active=30s --unit=gace-rx-pr345-health-20261109 /bin/bash -lc "$activation" >/dev/null
printf 'RECEIVER_HEALTH_SWITCH_SCHEDULED\n'
